categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three segments: personal protective products, rehabilitation care products, and other products. The personal protective segment focuses on disposable gloves including nitrile and PVC gloves, isolation gowns, and masks. Rehabilitation care includes wheelchairs, electric mobility devices, and walking aids. Other products cover health therapy items such as hot/cold packs and medical electrodes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced automated production lines with proprietary third-generation nitrile double-hand mold technology, precision distributed control systems (DCS), and automated formula adjustments based on environmental conditions. Manufacturing involves dipping and vulcanization processes for synthetic rubber gloves, with continuous upgrades to improve efficiency, reduce energy consumption, and maintain high product quality with over 99% yield rates.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include global medical institutions, elderly care facilities, food processing, electronics, industrial labor protection, and retail sectors. The company serves over 10,000 customers across more than 120 countries, including major markets in the Americas, Europe, Asia, Africa, and Oceania. The customer base comprises large international medical product wholesalers, retailers, e-commerce platforms, and trade companies.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company has a global footprint with production bases in China (Anhui, Jiangxi, Shandong, Jiangsu) and overseas operations in the US, Germany, Singapore, Vietnam, Canada, Japan, Malaysia, and Hong Kong. Sales cover over 120 countries and regions worldwide, with a strategic focus on diversifying away from the US market due to tariff barriers and expanding in emerging international markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, manufacturing disposable gloves and medical protective products. It also holds upstream positions through controlling and investing in nitrile latex raw material suppliers to secure stable raw material supply and improve cost control. The company manages an integrated supply chain covering raw materials, production, warehousing, logistics, and global sales.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include global supply chain optimization with overseas production bases to mitigate trade risks, continuous automation and AI integration in manufacturing, and expanding product portfolios with innovative glove types (e.g., biodegradable, high elasticity, cold-resistant). R&D focuses on new materials, improved formulations, and diversified personal protective equipment to enhance competitive barriers and meet evolving customer needs.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated predominantly through direct product sales of disposable gloves, rehabilitation devices, and other medical consumables. The company operates a self-sales model with no significant reliance on licensing or subscription. Sales are conducted via global distribution networks, e-commerce platforms, and direct contracts with institutional and commercial customers.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a global leader in disposable gloves and personal protective equipment, with significant market share in China and worldwide. It competes with other major glove manufacturers and medical supply companies, leveraging technological advantages, scale, and diversified global marketing. The company faces intensified competition due to industry overcapacity and pricing pressures but maintains leadership through innovation and supply chain integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 9.52 billion, a 37.65% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 1.47 billion, up 282.63%. Total assets reached RMB 34.63 billion, growing 27.89%. The company has demonstrated strong growth in sales volume and capacity expansion, with annual glove production capacity reaching 87 billion pieces. Cash flow from operations and R&D investment have also increased significantly.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, technologically advanced disposable gloves with superior comfort, elasticity, and safety, certified by FDA and CE. It offers a broad product range with multiple sizes and colors to meet diverse customer needs. Its competitive edge lies in integrated supply chain control, advanced automated production, global marketing reach, and continuous innovation in glove materials and manufacturing processes, enabling cost advantages and reliable supply.
